Key findings: Zwolle proper has only one starred restaurant — **De Librije (3★)**, the sole 3-star in the Netherlands. No 2-star exists within Zwolle. The closest 2-star, **De Groene Lantaarn (Staphorst, ~25 km)**, closes permanently on 3 May 2026 — already shut by the planned trip date. Practical fallbacks within ~30 min: **De Lindenhof (Giethoorn)** and **'t Nonnetje (Harderwijk)**.
